title: Team page: a hand-made team reads as managed by the identity provider, member rows are titled with raw ids, and the count is stale
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

Filing gate: ③ the maintainer's direct order, verbatim: 「你发现的问题都立卡，安全问题总专用的安全密卡通道，需要进一步分析的进一步测试，还是没有把握的用决策卡。」 (2026-11-05). Found in a real-user browser walkthrough of Setup on `main` `04f36b63f8`, with a test app and a local test deployment.

**Business reason.** Teams are how a company groups people for sharing. A label that reads as "not yours to change" and a list of id strings make a working feature look unusable.

**Reader.** The UI lane dev for the record page; the engine lane if the title comes from `sys_team_member`'s definition in `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-team-member.object.ts`.

**Duplicates.** Searched `team managed by identity provider label` (24 hits), `team member title raw id` (51 hits) and `related list tab count stale` (127 hits). They are QA run anchors; none has this subject.

## Measured

Creating a team, adding members and removing them all work, and a team used as a sharing rule's recipient grants and withdraws access at once. The problems are in how the page reads:

- A team I created by hand in Setup is labelled 「由身份提供方管理」 (`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh.ts:933`), though it can be edited there.
- The member list's 标题 column shows `ZDGI1SW5JmHgaiu6reGuHodMbgPr4AiZ in gGjBm6s3gDy1TcjUpkAz0L4d4AkaMmjo`.
- The tab read 团队成员 0 while the list said 2 条. After a removal it read 1 with 1 row, so it catches up late.

## Expected

- The label says something true of a team made here, or does not appear.
- Member rows read as names. If the title column adds nothing beside 用户, it goes.
- The tab count matches the list as soon as members change.
